```yaml
name: 'Stale Issues and PRs'

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            👋 Hello there! I'm reaching out to let you know that this issue has been automatically marked as stale due to inactivity.

            If this issue is still relevant and you'd like to keep it open, please leave a comment or add a reaction to prevent automatic closure. 
            We appreciate your contribution to keeping this project healthy!

            Thank you for your continued interest in this project! 🙏
          stale-pr-message: |
            👋 Hello there! I'm reaching out to let you know that this pull request has been automatically marked as stale due to inactivity.

            If this PR is still relevant and you'd like to keep it open, please leave a comment or add a reaction to prevent automatic closure. 
            We appreciate your contribution to keeping this project healthy!

            Thank you for your continued interest in this project! 🙏
          close-issue-message: |
            ❗ This issue has been automatically closed due to inactivity. 

            If you believe this was an error or if this issue is still relevant, please feel free to reopen it or create a new one. 
            We're always happy to help!

            Thanks for your understanding! 😊
          close-pr-message: |
            ❗ This pull request has been automatically closed due to inactivity. 

            If you believe this was an error or if this PR is still relevant, please feel free to reopen it or create a new one. 
            We're always happy to help!

            Thanks for your understanding! 😊
          days-before-stale: 90
          days-before-issue-stale: 90
          days-before-pr-stale: 90
          days-before-close: 60
          days-before-issue-close: 60
          days-before-pr-close: 60
          stale-issue-label: 'stale'
          stale-pr-label: 'stale'
          close-issue-label: 'closed-by-stale'
          close-pr-label: 'closed-by-stale'
          exempt-issue-labels: 'lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned'
          exempt-pr-labels: 'lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned'
          exempt-all-milestones: true
          exempt-all-assignees: true
          remove-stale-when-updated: true
```
